project_type: Angular 22 standalone-components frontend + FastAPI/SQLAlchemy/SQLite backend (separate backend/ dir).
build_system: Frontend: Angular CLI (@angular-devkit/build-angular:application), scripts in package.json. Backend: plain Python, deps in backend/requirements.txt, run via uvicorn. angular.json has NO fileReplacements, so src/environments/environment.ts is what builds (apiUrl='http://localhost:8000').
test_framework: Frontend: Karma/Jasmine (needs Chrome) via `ng test` — not reliable headless here; use the build as the compile gate. Backend: NO pytest in requirements.txt — verify with live uvicorn + curl and `python -c 'import main'` import checks.
build_command: Frontend: `cd /Users/irfan/Downloads/DashBoard-GenAI-master && npx ng build --configuration development`. Backend import check: `cd /Users/irfan/Downloads/DashBoard-GenAI-master/backend && python -c 'import main'`.
test_command: No automated test suite is used for verification. Primary gate = frontend dev build + backend import check + live curl exercise of PUT /orders/{id}/labels.
verification_instructions: 1) Backend edits: `cd backend && python -c 'import main'` must exit 0. 2) Live: run `uvicorn main:app --port 8000` from backend/, get a JWT from POST /auth/login (register a user via POST /auth/register if none seeded), then curl PUT /orders/<id>/labels with a normalized box list (expect 200 OrderOut with those detections), GET /orders/<id>/detections (same boxes), a second PUT replaces not appends, GET /orders/activity shows a 'Saved N labels' entry. 3) Frontend: `npx ng build --configuration development` compiles clean under strict + strictTemplates.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None. No generated/snapshot files are checked in. Do NOT delete the JSON asset files in src/assets (constraint) — services just stop reading them.
environment_constraints: Angular strict mode AND angularCompilerOptions.strictTemplates are on — template bindings and types are checked at build time. Do not hardcode URLs or tokens: use environment.apiUrl and auth.getToken(). For multipart uploads do NOT set Content-Type manually (browser sets the boundary) — see detection.service.ts. The chart's StatusChartService (assets/dataChart.json) and the auth login mock fallback are OUT OF SCOPE; leave them unchanged.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING.md present. Backend change must be additive/surgical: exactly one new endpoint + one new schema + re-exports; do not rewrite working routers (auth, uploads, yolo) or detection.service.ts/auth.service.ts. Match each file's existing style (aligned-colon formatting in backend schemas/routers; the HttpHeaders+Bearer pattern in frontend services).
key_patterns: Frontend auth header pattern (detection.service.ts): `const token = this.auth.getToken(); const headers = new HttpHeaders(token ? { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token } : {});`. Backend delete-then-insert pattern (yolo.py detect_order_images): `db.query(Detection).filter(Detection.order_id_fk == order.id).delete(); db.commit()` then add new Detection rows. Backend _log helper (orders.py) writes an ActivityLog row. Coordinate contract: Detection rows store NORMALIZED 0..1 coords; labeling canvas uses PIXELS; convert px->norm before PUT (divide by canvas w/h) and norm->px when loading (multiply) using live canvas.width/height, guarding non-finite values (mirror runDetection() in labeling.component.ts).
relevant_files: backend/routers/orders.py (add PUT /orders/{order_id}/labels; study _log, get_detections, existing router style)
backend/routers/yolo.py (STUDY the delete-then-insert + Detection construction pattern; do not change)
backend/routers/uploads.py (STUDY POST /uploads/single returning UploadResult; do not change)
backend/database.py (ORM: Order.order_id, Order.image_urls comma-separated, Detection normalized coords, ActivityLog)
backend/routers/auth.py (get_current_user Bearer dep; do not change)
src/app/services/order.service.ts (rewrite to backend; keep camelCase Order interface)
src/app/services/detection.service.ts (STUDY auth-header + multipart pattern; do not change)

directory_structure: backend/ = FastAPI app (main.py mounts routers auth/orders/uploads/yolo + serves /uploads; database.py ORM; schemas.py Pydantic; models/ re-exports schemas+orm; routers/ endpoints). src/app/ = Angular standalone components; services/ (order, labeling, detection, status-chart); auth/ (auth.service real JWT); dashboard/ and labeling/ components; config/order-columns.ts; environments/. src/assets/ holds the legacy mock JSON (keep files, stop reading).
